semiconductor_relevance: High — VAT Deutschland GmbH is a leading supplier of vacuum valves and related components critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: VAT Deutschland GmbH specializes in high-performance vacuum valves and systems essential for advanced semiconductor manufacturing and R&D. Their product offerings include vacuum valves, gas inlet valves, and custom engineering solutions, supporting various industries including semiconductors and photovoltaics.

regional_presence.Switzerland: The headquarters for development, laboratory, and assembly is located in Switzerland.
